text:
sophia: Canary blocked in ap-south — deploy-bot flagged missing SBOM provenance for native-lib v2.1.4. Change window ends in ~3h. Options: pin, regional carveout, or rollback?

deploy-bot: GATE FAILED — sbom_provenance: missing for artifact registry.redwood/cpp/native-lib:2.1.4. Canaries halted in ap-south. Actionable options: pin to 2.1.3, request evidence from builder, regional carveout, or full rollback.

alex: I can cut a regional pin PR (manifest + image override) scoped to ap-south canary, run quick smoke and resume canary. ETA ~30m.

ryan: Security: pin is acceptable as a timeboxed mitigation. Require mitigation plan in release notes, created ticket for follow-up (cosign attach + provenance verification). Need legal temporary exception sign-off.

maria: Legal: we can approve a 48h carveout if security documents mitigation & verifies cosign attach within SLA. Please include explicit rollback criteria.

chris: QA: carveout sounds fine. We'll run extended e2e for ap-south once the pin PR merges. Also update release notes and toggles for region flag.

sophia: Proposed rollback criteria: if customer-facing error rate >0.5% OR p99 latency regression >200ms in ap-south for 2 consecutive 10-min windows, trigger rollback. Owner: alex (on-call) for first 24h, then engineering oncall.

alex: Agree. I'll add this to the PR description + release notes and open ticket SEC-2026-0142 for the cosign attach.

alex: Commands I'll run in the PR (for audit):

```
# override image for ap-south canary
kubectl set image deploy/realtime-worker realtime-worker=registry.redwood/cpp/native-lib:2.1.3 -n prod-ap-south --record
# release manifest patch
sed -i 's/native-lib:2.1.4/native-lib:2.1.3/' k8s/releases/canary-ap-south.yaml
```

security-bot: temporary-carveout-request APPROVED by @ryan (sec) with 48h remediation SLA. Logged as SEC-2026-0142 :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: action=override-region-canary ap-south proceed with pinned image. Canary will resume after PR merge. Audit log created.

sophia: Thanks team. Maria — can you add the legal approval blurb to release notes? Alex will ping when PR is live.

maria: Added placeholder to release notes: "Regional carveout for ap-south due to SBOM provenance delay; security-approved temporary pin to 2.1.3; full verification pending cosign attach (SEC-2026-0142)." :white_check_mark: 

alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release/pull/4523 — running smoke now. Will ping if we need rollback. :rocket:
